definitions.scope: Real Chromium, offline deterministic provider; no claims about production/model/TUI speed.
definitions.firstDomMs: Send click capture to the first emitted text chunk in the assistant DOM (its unique run marker fits in that chunk), observed by MutationObserver. Not physical display paint.
definitions.firstSentenceMs: Send click to the complete first sentence in DOM. It spans two synthetic chunks, so it measures progress delivery after the eager first chunk.
definitions.completeDomMs: Send click to final marker in DOM; authoritative message also validated exactly. Runtime settlement can happen later.
definitions.sessionSetupMs: Node clock API creation of a fresh session/runtime. Measured separately from browser click/DOM; not a cold-process comparison.
definitions.warm: Later prompts in the same precreated session, with growing synthetic history. First prompt is excluded from warm median.
definitions.timing: Optional local stage diagnostic; missing on the old baseline. Client and server clocks must not be subtracted.

definitions.cold: First prompt in a new process with a fresh isolated agent directory. OS filesystem caches are not cleared.
definitions.warm: Later predefined prompts in the same Pi process/session, measured from the previous agent_settled record. Synthetic history grows between samples.
definitions.firstDelta: Parent process received the first nonempty JSON text_delta record; this is not terminal paint.
definitions.complete: Parent process received agent_settled after validating the authoritative assistant text and all deltas.
definitions.scope: Offline synthetic runtime/process overhead, including local scheduling. No inference about real provider, network, TUI or browser speed is valid.
